title: Pocket Planet: is it worth it?
passage: Last week I downloaded Pocket Planet, a new game for phones. You build your own small planet, plant trees and look after animals. The graphics are beautiful and the music is relaxing. I played it every evening, and my little brother loved it too. But there is one big problem: the game is free, but every new animal costs money. After three days I had no coins left! My advice: download it, but don't buy anything. I give it three stars out of five. — Max, 13

title: The Wrong Bus
passage: Last Friday our class went on a trip to the science museum. At the bus station, my friend Sam and I were talking about a video, and we got on the wrong bus! We only noticed when we saw the sea through the window. Sam's phone was dead, so I called our teacher, Ms Green. She wasn't angry — she was laughing. 'Get off at the next stop and wait there,' she said. Twenty minutes later, her car arrived. We missed the dinosaur show, but now everyone at school calls us 'the explorers'.

title: Why Are Teenagers Always Tired?
passage: Do you find it hard to get up in the morning? It's not because you're lazy. Scientists say that teenagers' bodies want to fall asleep later and wake up later than adults' bodies. Most teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep, but many get only six or seven. Phones make the problem worse, because the light from the screen tells your brain it's still daytime. So what can you do? Try to go to bed at the same time every night, and leave your phone outside your bedroom.

topic_en: Blog: a week without a phone
title: My No-Phone Week
passage: Last month my mum gave me a challenge: one week without my phone. If I did it, she promised to take me to a concert. The first two days were terrible. I didn't know what time it was, and I couldn't text my friends. On day three I found my old bike in the garage and rode to the park. On day five I finished a book — the first one this year! I did it, and I'm going to the concert next Saturday. But honestly? I didn't miss my phone as much as I expected.
